intro.en: Custom molded strain-relief cable assemblies that manage pull, bend and torsion at cable exits, with project-specific geometry, resin compatibility, insert control and validation.
intro.zh: 定制注塑应力消除线缆组件，在出线端管理拉力、弯曲与扭转，并按项目控制几何、材料相容性、嵌件定位及验证。

introduction.en: A Small Boot Carries a Large Mechanical Job
introduction.zh: 一个小护套，承担完整的机械任务

validation.en: Validation in the Real Use Envelope
validation.zh: 在真实使用边界内验证

faq.zh: 注塑应力消除常见问题

lead.en: A molded cable boot works between two components with very different stiffness: the connector or enclosure and the flexible cable. Its job is to spread pull, bend and torsion over a controlled transition instead of allowing the first conductor segment, terminal or solder joint to absorb every movement. Good results come from coordinating the cable, insert, resin, geometry, molding process and validation method as one system.
lead.zh: 注塑护套工作在两种刚度差异很大的部件之间：一侧是连接器或设备外壳，另一侧是柔性线缆。它需要把拉力、弯曲与扭转分散到受控过渡区，而不是让第一段导体、端子或焊点承受每次动作。可靠结果来自线缆、嵌件、树脂、几何、成型工艺与验证方法的系统配合。

title.en: Load Transfer: Move Stress Away from the Termination
title.zh: 载荷转移：让应力远离端接区

copy.en: Pull on the cable should be transferred through jacket grip, anchors and molded body before it reaches crimp wings, contacts or solder joints. The required retention depends on cable construction and use. A smooth exterior is not proof of load transfer; the internal anchor, adhesion or mechanical interlock must be defined and protected during molding.
copy.zh: 线缆受到拉力时，应先通过护套夹持、锚固结构与注塑主体传递，再到达压接翼、触点或焊点。所需保持能力取决于线缆结构和用途。表面光滑不能证明载荷已经转移；内部锚固、粘接或机械互锁需要被明确定义，并在成型中受到保护。

title.en: Bend Transition: Avoid an Abrupt Stiffness Step
title.zh: 弯曲过渡：避免刚度突然跳变

copy.en: A very short or very hard boot can simply move the bend peak to its outer edge, while an overly soft boot may provide little support. Transition length, taper, rib spacing, wall thickness and material hardness shape the curvature. The design should match the cable diameter, minimum installation envelope and expected movement rather than copying a familiar silhouette.
copy.zh: 过短或过硬的护套可能只是把弯曲峰值推到外缘，过软则可能几乎不起支撑作用。过渡长度、锥度、筋距、壁厚与材料硬度共同决定曲率。设计应匹配线缆直径、最小安装空间与预期动作，而不是复制一个熟悉的外形。

title.en: Exit Direction and Space: Design for the Installed Position
title.zh: 出线方向与空间：按安装状态设计

copy.en: Straight, angled and panel-exit strain reliefs occupy different envelopes. Nearby walls, fasteners, mating access and service loops determine where bending may begin. Drawings should establish the cable-exit angle, free length, permitted rotation and keep-out zone so installation does not force the boot into a permanent side load.
copy.zh: 直出、弯出与面板穿出处于不同空间包络。邻近壁面、紧固件、对插操作及检修余量都会决定弯曲可以从哪里开始。图纸应规定出线角度、自由长度、允许旋转及禁布区，避免安装后让护套长期承受侧向载荷。

title.en: Resin Selection: Compatibility Before Material Name
title.zh: 树脂选择：先判断相容性，再谈材料名称

copy.en: TPE, TPU, PVC, polyamide and other overmolding materials cover wide and non-interchangeable property ranges. The approved grade must suit jacket chemistry, insert material, target hardness, temperature, oils or cleaners, UV exposure and any flame requirement. A resin family name alone cannot establish adhesion, sealing or service life.
copy.zh: TPE、TPU、PVC、聚酰胺及其他包覆材料的性能范围很宽，彼此不能简单互换。认可牌号需要适配护套化学体系、嵌件材料、目标硬度、温度、油液或清洁剂、紫外线以及可能的阻燃要求。只有材料家族名称，不能证明粘接、密封或寿命。

title.en: Insert Preparation: Hold, Mask and Protect the Interface
title.zh: 嵌件准备：定位、遮蔽并保护接口

copy.en: Connector inserts, cable jackets, braids, drain wires and terminals must enter the tool in a repeatable condition. Fixtures control position and cable exit; masks keep resin away from mating faces, latches, vents and sealing lands. Pre-mold stripping, braid folding or surface preparation must be documented because hidden variation can change both retention and electrical performance.
copy.zh: 连接器嵌件、线缆护套、编织层、排流线与端子必须以可重复状态进入模具。治具负责定位与出线，遮蔽结构防止树脂进入插合面、锁扣、通气孔及密封面。预成型剥线、编织层翻折或表面处理必须形成文件，因为隐藏变化会同时影响保持力与电气性能。

title.en: Tooling and Process Window: Control More Than Shape
title.zh: 模具与工艺窗口：控制的不只是外形

copy.en: Shutoff surfaces, gate and vent location, cavity balance, injection pressure, material temperature and cooling affect flash, voids, sink, weld lines and insert movement. Excess pressure or heat can disturb conductors, seals or connector plastics. First-article review therefore includes critical dimensions, interface cleanliness and cable position, not only color and surface texture.
copy.zh: 封胶面、浇口与排气位置、型腔平衡、注射压力、材料温度和冷却会影响飞边、空洞、缩水、熔接线及嵌件位移。过高压力或温度还可能扰动导体、密封件或连接器塑料。首件检查因此要覆盖关键尺寸、接口洁净度与线缆位置，而不只是颜色和表面纹理。

title.en: Pull, Flex and Torsion: Test the Intended Failure Risks
title.zh: 拉力、弯折与扭转：针对预期失效验证

copy.en: Axial retention, side pull, repeated flexing and torsion reveal different weaknesses. The fixture, load, angle, speed, cycle count and pass criteria must come from the relevant product requirement or agreed project plan. Continuity during or after mechanical testing can reveal intermittent conductor, terminal or solder-joint damage that appearance alone misses.
copy.zh: 轴向保持、侧向拉力、反复弯折与扭转会暴露不同弱点。夹具、载荷、角度、速度、循环次数及判定标准必须来自适用产品要求或双方确认的项目计划。机械试验过程中或试验后的导通检查，可以发现仅凭外观难以识别的导体、端子或焊点间歇性损伤。

title.en: Environment and Sealing: Validate Only What the Assembly Claims
title.zh: 环境与密封：只验证组件实际宣称的能力

copy.en: Temperature cycling, moisture, splash, immersion, dust, oils and cleaning agents require different constructions and methods. A molded boot may improve protection without creating an IP-rated assembly. When sealing is required, define the complete boundary—including cable jacket, insert, mating connector and enclosure—and test the finished configuration after mechanical conditioning.
copy.zh: 温度循环、潮气、飞溅、浸水、粉尘、油液与清洁剂对应不同结构和方法。注塑护套可以提升防护，却不等于自动形成具备 IP 等级的组件。需要密封时，应定义包含线缆护套、嵌件、对插连接器及设备外壳在内的完整边界，并在机械预处理后验证成品配置。

title.en: Application Fit: One Method, Many Cable Categories
title.zh: 应用适配：同一种方法，服务多种线缆类别

copy.en: Molded strain relief is used on handheld tools, appliance cords, industrial sensors, USB and data leads, automotive low-voltage branches and panel pass-throughs. Each application shifts the priority between grip, bend life, sealing, cleanability, size and appearance. We review the host equipment and installation sequence before choosing a boot architecture.
copy.zh: 注塑应力消除可用于手持工具、家电电源线、工业传感器、USB 与数据引线、汽车低压分支及面板穿通。不同应用会重新排列夹持、弯折寿命、密封、可清洁性、尺寸和外观的优先级。确定护套结构前，我们会先审核目标设备与安装顺序。

specification.en: Connector or insert drawing, cable construction and exact jacket outside diameter.
specification.zh: 连接器或嵌件图纸、线缆结构及准确护套外径。

specification.en: Installed cable-exit direction, keep-out space, bend envelope and service loop.
specification.zh: 安装后的出线方向、禁布空间、弯曲包络与检修余量。

specification.en: Target resin, hardness, color and compatibility with the cable jacket and insert.
specification.zh: 目标树脂、硬度、颜色，以及与线缆护套和嵌件的相容性。

specification.en: Temperature, liquids, UV, flame, sealing and cleaning requirements that actually apply.
specification.zh: 实际适用的温度、液体、紫外线、阻燃、密封及清洁要求。

specification.en: Pull, bend, torsion or environmental test method with fixtures and acceptance criteria.
specification.zh: 拉力、弯折、扭转或环境试验方法，以及夹具和接收标准。

specification.en: Prototype quantity, tool ownership, cosmetic zones, inspection plan and traceability.
specification.zh: 样品数量、模具归属、外观区域、检验计划与追溯要求。

q.en: Does a longer strain-relief boot always improve flex life?
q.zh: 应力护套越长，弯折寿命一定越好吗？

a.en: No. Length works together with taper, ribs, wall thickness, hardness, cable diameter and the real bend direction. An unsuitable design can merely relocate the stress concentration.
a.zh: 不一定。长度需要与锥度、筋位、壁厚、硬度、线缆直径及真实弯曲方向共同作用；不合适的设计可能只是移动应力集中位置。

q.en: Can one overmold material be used on every cable jacket?
q.zh: 一种包覆材料可以用于所有线缆护套吗？

a.en: No. Adhesion, melt-temperature tolerance, shrinkage, chemical compatibility and required hardness vary. The exact resin and jacket combination needs review and, where necessary, trials.
a.zh: 不能。粘接、熔融温度耐受、收缩、化学相容性与所需硬度都会变化，准确树脂与护套组合需要审核，必要时还要试制。

q.en: Is an overmolded cable automatically waterproof?
q.zh: 做了注塑包覆就自动防水吗？

a.en: No. Waterproof performance belongs to the full sealing boundary and test configuration. Cable, insert, mating interface, enclosure and mechanical conditioning can all affect the result.
a.zh: 不是。防水性能属于完整密封边界和试验配置，线缆、嵌件、对插界面、外壳及机械预处理都会影响结果。

q.en: Can development begin from a physical sample?
q.zh: 可以从实物样品开始开发吗？

a.en: A sample helps recover visible geometry and fit, but hidden resin grade, jacket chemistry, internal anchors, test loads and service environment still require confirmation before production release.
a.zh: 样品有助于还原可见几何与配合，但隐藏的树脂牌号、护套化学体系、内部锚固、试验载荷与使用环境仍需在量产放行前确认。
